sections.text: Most SaaS teams don't need a full-time designer to fix their product. They need *senior judgment, every week*, on what to improve next.
prose: A fractional product designer works inside your team like an employee would: same tools, same rituals, same backlog. The difference is the commitment. You buy the hours you need, at a senior level, without recruiting, onboarding or managing a full-time hire.

Our work starts with an audit of your product and its numbers, then turns into a weekly or monthly cadence of improvements: onboarding, activation, pricing pages, key workflows and the design system that keeps it all consistent.

sections.h2: Frequently asked questions about *fractional product design*
Ready to add a *senior designer* to your team?
sections.p: Tell us about your product. We'll suggest the role and the hours that fit.

faq.q: What is a fractional product designer?
a: A fractional product designer is a senior designer who works part time inside your team, usually a few hours to a few days a week, on an ongoing basis. You get senior UX/UI expertise without the cost and commitment of a full-time hire.

faq.q: How much does a fractional product designer cost?
a: At Viesigners, for startups and scale-ups, from US$3,450 a month for a product designer at 5 hours a week. Lead product designer starts at about US$3,900 and head of design at about US$4,350 a month. The hourly rate drops by 10% at 10 hours a week, 20% at 15 hours and 25% at 20 hours. Enterprises and large product teams get a custom quote based on the user base, the business impact and the level of involvement.

faq.q: What's the difference between a fractional product designer and a fractional head of design?
a: A product designer does the hands-on design work: flows, screens, prototypes and tests. A head of design sets the product and UX strategy with leadership, reviews the team's work and helps hire designers. Both can be booked for the same number of hours; the role sets the rate.
5 hours a week, billed monthly. You can change the role or the number of hours from one month to the next.

faq.q: Do you work with our developers and tools?
a: Yes. We work inside your tools and rituals (Figma, Jira or Linear, Slack or Teams, sprint reviews) and hand off designs your developers can build.

faq.q: Do you work with teams outside Canada?
a: Yes. We're based in Vancouver and Quebec City and work in English and French with teams in the United States, Canada and Europe.
